Attached Form 10
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Attached Form 10] <Amended on October 1, 2025>

APPLICATION FOR DESIGNATION OF AN EXCELLENT ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION PROGRAM

The applicant shall not complete the dark-shaded fields.

Receipt number: __________
Date of receipt: __________
Processing date: __________
Processing period: 80 days

Applicant
Institution name (corporate name): __________
Representative: __________
Address: __________
Telephone number: __________
Mobile telephone number: __________
Email address: __________

Application details
Program name: __________
Target participants: __________
Training hours – Total: ____ / Lectures: ____ / Practical training: ____
Educational content: __________
Method of delivery: __________
Instructor qualifications: __________
Scheduled opening date: __________

I hereby apply for designation of an excellent environmental education program under Article 21(2) of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education and Article 9(2) of its Enforcement Rule.

Year ____ Month ____ Day ____
Applicant: __________ (signature or seal)

To: Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

Accompanying documents
Documents proving compliance with the requirements in each subparagraph of Article 9(1) of the Enforcement Rule of the Environmental Education Promotion Act.

Fee: None

Processing procedure

| Step | Responsible party |
| --- | --- |
| Preparation of the application | Applicant |
| Receipt | Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment or Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries (department responsible for environmental education) |
| Verification | Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (department responsible for environmental education) |
| Deliberation | Subcommittee for Designating Excellent Environmental Education |
| Decision | Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (department responsible for environmental education) |
| Issuance of the certificate of designation of an excellent environmental education program | Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (department responsible for environmental education) |

210 mm × 297 mm [white paper (80 g/m²)]
